design_references.title: Fleet CPG Engine — Phase 1 (Prove the core thesis)
design_references.claim: Overlay commits must merge into a base snapshot without copying it (O(diff) storage and write cost, not O(repo)), and the merged view must be indistinguishable from a from-scratch full-repo extraction at the same commit, or the COW-overlay design is falsified. fleet-cpg-phase1-overlay-zod measured only the extraction/lowering half of Phase 1; this experiment measures the commit-into-a-store half it explicitly left open.

hypothesis: A committed overlay layer (defs/calls extracted for only the files a real merged PR touched) merges with a base snapshot, at query time and without copying the base, into a view that is set-identical to a from-scratch full-repo extraction at the PR's head commit -- and overlay storage, commit-write time, and merge-query time all stay small relative to the base snapshot and to full-repo rebuild cost, across PRs of varying diff size.
null_hypothesis: The merged view diverges from the from-scratch ground-truth extraction on any bucket or repetition, or overlay storage/write/merge cost approaches the same order of magnitude as the base snapshot or a full-repo rebuild.
independent_variable: Which real merged zod PR is committed as an overlay (three buckets by diff size: small, medium, large -- same PRs as fleet-cpg-phase1-overlay-zod for continuity), holding the base snapshot, extractor, source repo, and base revision fixed.

environment.network_justification: git clone of zod from github.com (already materialized from fleet-cpg-baseline-zod / fleet-cpg-phase1-overlay-zod). No other endpoints.

variants.name: small
variants.description: Real merged PR #6511 (5ff9566): 2 files, 8 lines changed in packages/zod/src.

variants.name: medium
variants.description: Real merged PR #6488 (212b941): 3 files, 38 lines changed in packages/zod/src.

variants.name: large
variants.description: Real merged PR #5913 (555e5f4): 6 files, 241 lines changed in packages/zod/src.

metrics.acceptance_rule: Accept: every repetition of every bucket has defs_match_truth and calls_match_truth both true, and median overlay_to_base_bytes_ratio stays well under 0.1 (base is not being duplicated). Reject: any correctness mismatch on any repetition, or storage/write/merge cost approaching base-snapshot scale.

evaluator.rubric: Score on: (1) the merged view (base snapshot with untouched files, unioned with the overlay layer for touched files) is byte-for-byte set-equal, on defs and calls, to a from-scratch full-repo extraction at the PR's head commit, across every repetition -- any mismatch is a hard correctness failure of the COW-merge mechanism, not something to average away; (2) overlay storage cost (defs.parquet + calls.parquet for the touched files only) is a small fraction of base snapshot size, confirming the base is never duplicated; (3) commit-write and merge-query wall time stay small in absolute terms (milliseconds, not seconds) so the commit path doesn't reintroduce the O(repo) cost the extraction half already avoided.
